name: ingest
what_happens: read new report lines from the ledger; dial changes from classifier readings; news_overload from report count

name: dial_update
what_happens: each dial: multiply by event factors, then drift back toward 1 at its own half-life; optimism computed from the others

name: perceive
what_happens: each persona perceives each dial through its own salience (and region, once regional dials exist)

name: modify_elements
what_happens: effective element = base element x product over dials of perceived dial ^ strength (grid)

name: persist
what_happens: blend with the previous state (inertia), as in ConsumerSim; strength fitted on a calibration period

name: gates
what_happens: for each decision met this tick, act with probability sigmoid(bias + sum of weights x standardised elements)

name: log
what_happens: write dial values, events, per-cohort rates and the cause of each change to the ledger
